notes: Run of 2026-11-22. Four Hoodline stories queued; one names a building — a delayed bakery opening on Polk Street — and it is declined. The others are a conviction, an arrest and a BART fatality, none a building fact.

findings.description: A PG&E power problem on Polk Street pushed the bakery's opening at 2139 Polk into next year.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Polk Street Power Mess Delays Lorella Bakery, Bageletto Into Next Year,” 21 November 2026

raw.text: Delays Lorella Bakery, Bageletto Into Next Year

publish.note: Declined: fails the ten-year test. A delayed opening is not something that happened to the building; the page already carries the bakery's announcement (The San Francisco Standard, 21 July 2026), and the opening itself, when it happens, is the entry.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 2139 POLK ST → parcel 0571003; sf-parcels has blklot 0571003 active, 2139–2141 POLK; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1933. EAS puts 2139, 2141 POLK ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 2139.
